creator: Claude
name: Kitchen Wall Cabinet
source_format: MagicaVoxel VOX v150 (SIZE, XYZI, RGBA), single model

derived.glb_note: Derived from the .vox by tools/claude/export_glb.py; do not edit by hand. Linear COLOR_0 vertex colours, one material.

resolution_rationale: 5 cm cells (the library's furniture/prop tier): real member thicknesses (boards, rails, cushions, doors) stay believable instead of toy-like; matches the game's 0.05 m character rig.
godot_mapping: godot = ((vx - px) * s, (vz - pz) * s, -(vy - py) * s)
pivot_note: Bottom centre of the back face (the cabinet body, not the open door). Hang with the back on the wall; bottom at about 1.45 m (0.55 m over the 0.90 m worktop).
front_note: +Y faces into the room; the back (y = 0) is flat for the wall.
dimensions_note: Occupied extents of the voxel grid (X width, Y depth, Z height).
palette: Shared Claude palette v2 (tools/claude/voxkit.py); one material family per 8-swatch row in MagicaVoxel's palette grid.
collision_hint: Box 1.05 x 0.35 x 0.75 m for the body; the open door adds a 0.05 x 0.50 m leaf at the right end.
story: Hung above the counter, it held the everyday plates and cups. The right-hand door was left standing open; most of the cups are gone, the plates were left because nobody needed plates any more.
notes: Closed body 1.05 x 0.35 x 0.75 m (GPT reference 1.06 x 0.36 x 0.76 m). The open door is part of the story and adds 0.50 m of depth at the right end only.
